cases.study_information: All constructs are full-length human IgG1 anti-GCGR antibodies. DLS was performed at 25.0 C in 20 mM histidine acetate, pH 5.5, using approximately 2-10 mg/mL protein. Viscosity was measured by cone-and-plate rheometry at 180 mg/mL IgG1, 25.0 C, in the same formulation. The parent is a visible reference and must not be included in the answer. sequence1 and sequence2 are VH and VL; constant domains are shared.

dependence_note: Shared sources must be interpreted at the study-family level.
title: Predicting dilute-solution self-interaction of local antibody variants
